![](images/c7/c76cff47179efaaf490430856b8db1f2b85f0d2000d34725a9c40a9e150ccf6b.png)

Find the arc length of the curve $\mathbf{r}(t)=⟨\operatorname{ln}t,\hspace{0.222em}2t,\hspace{0.222em}{t}^{2}⟩$
from $t = 1$ to $t = e$.
corrected_content.worked_solution:
For $t>0$ the speed simplifies as
$$\sqrt{t^{-2}+4+4t^2}=2t+\frac1t.$$
Thus the length is
$$\int_1^e\left(2t+\frac1t\right)dt=[t^2+\ln t]_1^e=(e^2+1)-1=e^2.$$
